title: fix: list Floret and Polli capabilities in the model catalog
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Endpoint-agent owners can now register and update capabilities, then read them back through Enter. Updates that omit the field preserve the stored value. The shared schema accepts tool_calling, reasoning, web_search, code_execution and pollinations_models; Gen carries those traits into /models, capability filtering and fallback compatibility. Proxy listings retain their narrower capability list so they do not claim search or code execution on behalf of an upstream provider. The PR also describes a guarded, idempotent data repair for the Floret and Polli listings, whose public catalog entries had empty capabilities; Floret’s listed traits include web_search and code_execution.
